data.name: Falcons of the Red Planet
data.detailed_description:
Imagine an alternative universe—just one of many possibilities. The Cold War dragged on for centuries, splitting the world into two sides: the Alliance of Empires and the Red Brotherhood. And that was until passing comet transformed the Solar System into something resembling a raging ocean. Everything changed: astronavigation, telescopic observation, and even the conditions for life on Earth.

To save humanity, the Alliance and the Brotherhood worked together to restore navigation, build a network of relays and gravity bridges, terraform planets, and colonize asteroids. But the peace was short-lived.

During the terraforming of Mars, the Red Brotherhood colony discovered deposits of an incredibly valuable super-heavy element in a stable form beneath the polar ice. Accusations of misappropriating a strategic resource flew, and the conflict reignited with renewed intensity. Most colonies bowed to the Alliance's iron fist—but not Mars. The Red Planet continues to fight for freedom in the Solar System.

Play through the single-player campaign as warriors of the Red Brotherhood: Anna Kuznetsova, Vasily Chapayev, and Pyotr Orlov.

Battle the Alliance’s horde of soulless robots in space and beyond. Fight piloting unic combat machines—starfighters capable of transforming into giant robots. You won't always be inside a vehicle, somtimes you will have to rely solely on your trusty plasma gun and saber. High-speed hovercycle chases through the narrow canyons of distant planets and asteroids also await you in this adventure.

As you fight for your ideals, you will cross your way with of heroes and villains—such as mad Baroness von Boornash, commander of the Alliance’s punitive corps; Admiral Morgan, commander of the Free Fleet; or Vasilisa Klimova, commander of a Mars Space Force's frigate.

Your loyal comrade—the Adaptive Learning Interactive Celestial Evaluator (A.L.I.C.E.)—will assist you during reconnaissance missions discovering Alliance’s darkest secrets.

Welcome aboard, comrade!
